text:
alex: Just noticed a regen diff in typegen after the auth/retry middleware change. sample-app's eslint/typecheck fails when pulling the published package.

morgan: hmm — CI showed a regen diff too?

ci-bot: build #3821 failed (devex/typegen-pipeline) — regen diff detected on CHANGELOG and types output. View: <https://ci.internal/redwood/3821> :rotating_light:

alex: repro steps: checkout main, npm i @redwood-inference/sdk@latest, run yarn build && yarn tsc in sample-app. Error: 
```
node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.d.ts: exported variable 'RetryOptions' has different shape
```

jin: did the auth retry change bump a minor? I thought it was a patch.

morgan: The PR was #2149 — we changed default retry backoff fields (added jitter flag). PR description mentioned semver-minor but the package.json patch remained.

kate: oh that explains it. typegen regenerates based on the generated openapi schema -> new optional field causes different TS shape. We need to either revert shape or do a minor publish and update changelog.

samir: Quick ask: can we run the typegen locally and commit the regen? CI is blocking other releases.

alex: I ran `yarn -w tools/typegen run regen --yes` and got these files modified: packages/typegen/dist/types.ts, sdk/dist/index.d.ts, CHANGELOG.md. I pushed a draft branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2157

morgan: Can CI run with allow-regens option? We intentionally fail on regen diffs to make sure types stay checked. Not comfortable skipping the guard.

jin: Agreed — we shouldn't bypass. Two options: 1) update sdk package.json semver to minor and publish with changelog entry; 2) make the field backward compatible (keep old shape but deprecate). Which is faster?

kate: Option 1 is fast if we update CHANGELOG and bump. But we have downstream parity requirements: devex sample apps rely on patch semantics for the last week. Might need a temporary compatibility shim.

alex: I'm leaning to shim + patch so we don't bump minor while releasing other hotfixes. Quick patch add: keep RetryOptions with both 'jitter' optional and preserve old field names, then regenerate types, CI should pass with a patch publish.

samir: I'll open a tiny PR to add the shim + test. Can someone from release engineering sign off on doing a patch publish in the middle of the release queue? @morgan

morgan: I'll coordinate with release-scheduler. If it's a patch that preserves API, we're fine. Please include a clear changelog entry: "fix(sdk): maintain RetryOptions backward compatibility (regen)"

ci-bot: @samir triggered run: tools/typegen regen -> started.

alex: Also can we add a small integration test in sample-app that installs the published tarball and runs typecheck in CI so we catch this earlier? The current pipeline only checks local typegen outputs.

kate: yes — add a `postpublish-smoke` matrix job that uses `npm pack` and `npm install` in a fresh env. Low flakiness if we pin node.

jin: I'll file a follow-up ticket for that in infra: INFRA-789.

samir: PR #2160 up with shim + regenerated types + changelog. Fingers crossed.

morgan: Thanks. once CI green, i'll coordinate the patch publish and update release notes. :thumbsup:

alex: and let's add an explicit note in the typegen README about semver expectations when changing shapes that feed into SDK types. saves future headaches.

kate: agreed. small doc patch would help new contributors.

ci-bot: build #3823 (after regen PR) — all checks passed. artefact ready for publish.

alex: nice — closing the loop. thanks everyone :)
